q: Through which constitutional amendment did women get the vote for the Folketing?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2020, June 2021 and June 2022 exams.

da.q: Ved hvilken grundlovsændring fik kvinder valgret til Folketinget?

learn.text: Women and servants, that is, people without their own household, who served and lived with another family, did not get the vote. This only happened with the constitution of 1915. Since then, the voting age for the Folketing has gradually been lowered from thirty years down to the present voting age of eighteen years, which was adopted in 1978.

q: What was adopted with the constitutional amendment of 1915?

options.t: That women could inherit the Danish throne
That women got the vote for the Folketing
That women had to serve conscription

answerText: That women got the vote for the Folketing
appeared: It appeared in the May 2025 exam.

da.q: Hvad blev vedtaget med grundlovsændringen i 1915?

At kvinder fik stemmeret til Folketinget

learn.text: It can only be changed with support from both the Folketing and the population. Women got the vote with the constitution of 1915. The voting age of eighteen was adopted in 1978.

q: Between whom are the legislative, the executive and the judicial power divided?

options.t: The Folketing, the government and the courts
The Folketing, the regions and the courts
The government, the regions and the municipalities

answerText: The Folketing, the government and the courts
appeared: It appeared in 4 different exams, most recently in November 2025.

da.q: Hvem er den lovgivende, den udøvende og den dømmende magt fordelt mellem?

learn.text: The separation of powers means that the government and the Folketing together make laws, the legislative power. It is the government that, through the ministries, administers the laws in practice and puts them into effect, the executive power. The third power is the courts, the judicial power.
